findings.current: The canyon was absurdly narrow, though not exactly small.
findings.defect: Reverses the description of the canyon’s width.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly says the canyon is not absurdly narrow.
findings.replacement: The canyon wasn’t absurdly narrow, but it wasn’t wide, either.
findings.source: 터무니없이 좁은 협곡은 아니지만, 그렇다고 해서 넓은 것도 아니다.

findings.current: When the Skeleton King’s undead had relayed what was happening, Choi had felt both surprise and disappointment. Before long, though, those feelings had turned to joy.
findings.defect: “Disappointment” misses Choi’s feeling of being slighted or left out.
findings.rationale: 섭섭함 conveys a personal sense of hurt or exclusion, not merely disappointment with the news.
findings.replacement: When the Skeleton King’s undead had relayed what was happening, Choi had felt both surprised and a little left out. Before long, though, those feelings had turned to joy.
findings.source: 스켈레톤 킹이 보낸 언데드를 통해 상황을 전달받았을 때는 놀라움과 섭섭함을 동시에 느꼈지만, 그 감정들은 머지않아 기쁨으로 바뀌었다.

findings.current: Even so, the fanatics whom the Doppelganger had cultivated for many years broke through the undead ranks in an instant.
findings.defect: “Broke through” changes the described action from collapsing a battle line to passing through it.
findings.rationale: 전열을 허물어트렸다 describes destroying the formation.
findings.replacement: Even so, the fanatics whom the Doppelganger had cultivated for many years shattered the undead battle line in an instant.
findings.source: 그러나 오랜 세월 동안 도플갱어가 육성한 광신도들은 단번에 언데드로 이루어진 전열(戰列)을 허물어트렸다.

findings.current: He had to fight. He couldn’t be the first to fall.
findings.defect: Changes Choi’s resolve not to fall before the enemy into a resolve not to be the first person to fall.
findings.rationale: 적들보다 먼저 makes the enemies, not everyone on the battlefield, the point of comparison.
findings.replacement: He had to fight. He couldn’t fall before the enemy did.
findings.source: 싸워야 한다. 적들보다 먼저 쓰러져서는 안 된다.

findings.current: And those tiny cracks helped someone who should never have been set free regain even a little of his freedom.
findings.defect: Attaches “even a little” to the amount of freedom regained rather than to the cracks’ contribution.
findings.rationale: 조금이나마 qualifies how much the cracks helped; the source does not say he regained only partial freedom.
findings.replacement: And those tiny cracks helped, if only a little, to free someone who should never have escaped.
findings.source: 그리고 그 미세한 균열은, 풀려나서는 안 될 누군가가 자유를 되찾는 것을 조금이나마 도왔다.

findings.current: His mind was calm. The sword in his hand felt as light as a black feather.
findings.defect: Adds a color to the feather that is absent from the source.
findings.rationale: 검은 is 검, “sword,” followed by the topic particle 은; it does not describe a black feather.
findings.replacement: His mind was calm. The sword in his hand felt as light as a feather.
findings.source: 마음이 고요하다. 손에 들린 검은 깃털처럼 가볍다.
